title: Frontend maintainability refactor (break up large components)
description: Umbrella epic to break up large frontend components into smaller units without behavior changes.
acceptance_criteria: - Child refactor tasks completed\n- Frontend builds (npm run build)\n- Core app flows smoke-tested

title: Split Sidebar into focused subcomponents
description: Extract cohesive Sidebar sections into dedicated components.
acceptance_criteria: - Sidebar broken into smaller components under src/components/sidebar/\n- No behavior change (nav, shortcuts, counters, dialogs)\n- Tests/build pass

title: Consolidate Task*Display dropdown pattern
description: Extract shared dropdown shell + click-outside logic used across Task*Display components.
acceptance_criteria: - useClickOutside hook added\n- Shared dropdown component used\n- No behavior changes

title: Extract optimistic task update helper
description: Create a shared helper/hook for optimistic task updates used by task display components.
acceptance_criteria: - Shared helper used by Task*Display components\n- Rollback behavior preserved\n- Error handling consistent

title: Reduce MainApp routes duplication by extracting route tree
description: Extract duplicated <Routes> tree into a reusable component used by all layouts.
acceptance_criteria: - AppRoutes component created\n- MainApp uses it across layouts\n- No route changes

title: Refine ShortcutContext boundaries (optional follow-up)
description: Reduce ShortcutContext complexity (split or use discriminated union state).
acceptance_criteria: - ShortcutContext simplified\n- Dialog/shortcut behavior unchanged\n- Consumers updated

title: Extract keyboard shortcut handling from Sidebar
description: Move keyboard shortcut event handling out of Sidebar into a hook.
acceptance_criteria: - Shortcut logic in a hook with correct cleanup\n- Sidebar consumes hook via small callback API\n- No shortcut behavior regressions

title: Split ViewPage into container + sections
description: Break ViewPage.tsx into smaller components (header/actions/body/side panels).
acceptance_criteria: - ViewPage becomes orchestration only\n- Extracted components have clear props\n- Routing/URL behavior unchanged

title: Split EditPage into container + editor sections
description: Break EditPage.tsx into smaller editor sections (toolbar/body/metadata).
acceptance_criteria: - Toolbar/editor/metadata extracted\n- Save/preview behavior unchanged\n- Build passes

title: Split SearchPage into form/config/results components
description: Extract SearchPage.tsx into focused subcomponents for maintainability.
acceptance_criteria: - Search form + results + config separated\n- No behavior changes in search UX\n- Build/tests pass

title: Split CardBodyTextArea into editor + helper hooks
description: Extract sub-behaviors (formatting, drag-drop, reference insertion) from CardBodyTextArea.
acceptance_criteria: - Hooks extracted; component complexity reduced\n- Imperative editor behavior preserved\n- No regressions in editing UX

title: Split ViewCardTabbedDisplay into per-tab components
description: Extract Metadata/Facts/Audit tabs and move helpers into utils.
acceptance_criteria: - Per-tab components created\n- Diff helpers moved to utils\n- Tab behavior unchanged

title: Split EntityDialog into data hooks + sections
description: Extract EntityDialog sections and embedded dialogs into dedicated components.
acceptance_criteria: - Sections extracted (cards/facts/similar/header)\n- Merge/convert dialogs extracted\n- Data loads behave the same

title: Split TaskForm into sections
acceptance_criteria: - TaskForm decomposed into subcomponents\n- Prop contracts remain compatible\n- No task editing regressions
